QuestInfo.name: Monsters of the Excavation Site
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies has another favor to ask you.
QuestInfo.1: A new type of monster recently showed up at the Excavation Site. Ask Winston what's going on.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Winston about the new monsters that appeared at the Excavation Site.

0.0: #h0#! I'm glad to see you! Did you do finish doing that favor for me?
0.1: Oh yeah, it looks like Blackbull and Ayan aren't on very good terms... But whatever. I have a request for you!
0.2: I hear that weird monsters are popping up in the Excavation Site. Would you mind asking Winston if he's learned anything about them?\r\n#b(You will be moved to #m102020400# if you accept.)#k

no.0: What? You don't want to? What kind of attitude is that...?

1.0: Hm, hm. Even those Cygnus chaps know about the strange monsters that showed up here.

yes.0: That nice fellow #p9040002# told me about them. He says these new monsters are getting in the way of his excavation work, and wants them to be eliminated.
